summary.text: Glenn Bill is the Republican candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Edward DeLaney.
A real estate professional and lifelong Indianapolis resident, he lists roads and infrastructure, property tax relief, economic development and public safety among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Glenn Bill graduated from Bishop Chatard High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of District 86 and Indianapolis, received a football scholarship to Ball State University, and attended Butler University and IUPUI as a political science major.
He said he built a real estate brokerage business, was a Top 10 broker and owner of CENTURY 21 At the Crossing Inc., and eventually sold it to a competitor.
Bill said he served on nonprofit boards of directors, coached youth sports, and spent 25 years as a high school football position coach at his alma mater.
He said he has been married to his wife Colleen for 38 years and has four children and six grandchildren.
Bill advanced from the Republican primary for District 86 on May 5, 2026.

His stated campaign themes are "People NOT Politics," delivering results for District 86, and protecting paychecks, and his policy interests include fixing potholes, property tax relief, new commercial development and supporting law enforcement.
